items.name: Summer Cucumber Fennel Salad

items.name: Summer Pear Fennel Pomegranate Plate

ingredients.name: Pear, cored and cut into thin slices

steps: Rinse the pear, fennel bulb, and pomegranate arils for 30 seconds, drain thoroughly, and dry the cut surfaces before assembling Summer Pear Fennel Pomegranate Plate; let all components reach room temperature for 10 minutes.
Fan the pear slices around the thin fennel. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Add pomegranate and mint to the center of the plate. Lift and turn the pieces for 30 seconds with the heat off, stopping before the crisp edges bruise or release moisture.
Serve promptly as a dairy-free summer fruit course. Wait 1 minute at room temperature, taste a small piece or spoonful, and correct the salt or acidity before the final assembly.
Let Summer Pear Fennel Pomegranate Plate stand at room temperature for 7 minutes, keep the composed sections distinct, and serve at midday before the cut surfaces release excess liquid.

items.name: Summer Avocado Tomato Cucumber Plate

ingredients.name: Avocado, peeled and cut into cubes

steps: Measure 12 g (about 1 tablespoon) of oil and 16 g (about 1 tablespoon) of citrus into a small jar; shake for 20 seconds and hold the dressing until the final assembly.
Arrange avocado, tomato, and cucumber in distinct sections. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Scatter cilantro over all three without mixing them heavily. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Season with a little oil, lime, and salt just before lunch. Wait 1 minute at room temperature, taste a small piece or spoonful, and correct the salt or acidity before the final assembly.
Let Summer Avocado Tomato Cucumber Plate stand at room temperature for 4 minutes, keep the composed sections distinct, and serve at midday before the cut surfaces release excess liquid.

items.name: Summer Beet Carrot Cucumber Plate
steps: For Summer Beet Carrot Cucumber Plate, measure 16 g (about 1 tablespoon) of oil and 16 g (about 1 tablespoon) of citrus into a small jar; shake for 20 seconds and hold the dressing until the final assembly.
Place the grated roots in separate bright mounds. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Add cucumber and mint between them as a cool divider. Wait 1 minute at room temperature, taste a small piece or spoonful, and correct the salt or acidity before the final assembly.

items.name: Summer Zucchini Cabbage Fennel Plate
steps: For Summer Zucchini Cabbage Fennel Plate, measure 16 g (about 1 tablespoon) of oil and 16 g (about 1 tablespoon) of citrus into a small jar; shake for 20 seconds and hold the dressing until the final assembly.
Twist the zucchini ribbons beside the cabbage mound. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Layer fennel and dill over the join between them. Keep the layer loose and even, with no pooled liquid, so every portion receives the same balance.
Add oil, lemon, and salt and keep the textures distinct. Drizzle for 20–30 seconds with the heat off, moving around the plate so every section is seasoned without being stirred together.
Let Summer Zucchini Cabbage Fennel Plate stand at room temperature for 3 minutes, keep the composed sections distinct, and serve at midday before the cut surfaces release excess liquid.
